pages.title: What AiAlgoDesk does
pages.description: An AI Copilot, an option chain with OI, setups, a paper trading bot, a journal and a daily report for Indian markets.
pages.intro: AiAlgoDesk is one place to read the market, practise your own ideas on paper and keep a record of how you trade.

sections.heading: AI Copilot
lines: Ask in plain words about a chart, an idea or a setting, and get an answer in plain words.
It explains. It never places, blocks or changes an order.

sections.heading: Option chain with OI
lines: Open interest shown in lakhs, with the key numbers explained in plain words.

sections.heading: Find setups
lines: Scan the market for the structure you chose and see what matches in one list.

sections.heading: AI Trading Bot on paper
lines: A bot follows the idea and the settings you chose, with pretend money.

sections.heading: Journal
lines: Every paper trade is recorded, so you can review it and practise again.

sections.heading: Daily report on Telegram
lines: A short daily market report in the app, and on your own Telegram when you turn it on.

pages.title: How it works
pages.description: Start in three steps: continue with Google, connect your broker if you want live prices, and practise on paper.

sections.heading: Continue with Google
lines: Sign in with your Google account, or with your email.

sections.heading: Connect your broker if you want live prices
lines: This step is optional. ATP reads prices through your own broker account. Your broker login stays with your broker.

sections.heading: Practise on paper
lines: Pick an idea, set your own settings and practise with pretend money. Every paper trade lands in your journal.

pages.title: About AiAlgoDesk
pages.description: A trading workspace for retail traders in India: education, analysis and paper practice. Questions and answers.
pages.intro: AiAlgoDesk is built for traders who want to learn to read the market by its structure and practise with discipline.

sections.heading: No order is placed without you
lines: The AI explains. It never places, blocks or changes an order.

sections.heading: Your broker data stays yours
lines: Data from your broker account is kept in your own account, not shared with other accounts.

sections.heading: Paper by default
lines: You practise with pretend money. No order reaches your broker.

sections.heading: What we do not do
lines: We do not tell anyone what to trade and we make no promise about results.
Most individual traders in futures and options lose money. Please read the risk disclosure before you trade.

faq.question: Which brokers can I connect?
faq.answer: Zerodha, Upstox, Angel One, Dhan, Fyers, Groww, Shoonya and more. A broker is needed only for live prices.

faq.question: Is my money safe?
faq.answer: ATP never holds your money. Practice runs on paper with pretend money, and no order reaches your broker without you.

faq.question: What is paper trading?
faq.answer: Practice with pretend money: you follow the market and see how your idea would do, and no order goes to your broker.
